findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Algebra/Order/Group/Unbundled/Int.lean:54` `lemma natAbs_le_self_sq (a : ℤ) : (Int.natAbs a : ℤ) ≤ a ^ 2`; `Mathlib/Data/Int/…/Int.lean:44` `@[norm_cast] lemma natCast_natAbs (n : ℤ) : (n.natAbs : ℤ) = |n|`.
findings.fix: Replace lines 212-217 with the Mathlib fact: `have : |(P.intersectionMatrix *ᵥ x) v| ≤ (P.intersectionMatrix *ᵥ x) v ^ 2 := by rw [← Int.natCast_natAbs]; exact Int.natAbs_le_self_sq _` then `exact this.trans hbound`. The zero case and the `nlinarith` both disappear.
findings.issue: Deriving `|A x v| ≤ N` from `(A x v)^2 ≤ N` is done by a case split on the coordinate being zero plus `nlinarith [sq_abs …]` with an `Int.one_le_abs` hint (lines 212-217). This is a nonlinear-arithmetic call hiding the standard fact `|a| ≤ a ^ 2` over ℤ, and nlinarith with hand-picked hints is exactly the brittle-but-short style the rubric warns about.

findings.evidence: Sublevel.lean:148-159: goal after `refine (Set.Finite.preimage hinj.injOn hfin).subset fun x hx => ?_` is `x ∈ (fun x => (2 * det) • x + adjugate A *ᵥ k) ⁻¹' {x | c' ≤ P.intersectionForm x x}`, closed by `exact hgoal` where `hgoal` is the raw inequality. No `Set.mem_setOf_eq`/`Set.mem_preimage` appears anywhere in `TauCeti/LowDimTopology/Plumbing` (grep).
findings.fix: Open the membership explicitly at each site — `simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx ⊢` after the `refine … .subset fun x hx => ?_` — and then finish with the `rw`/`linarith` directly, dropping the `have hgoal … exact hgoal` indirection.
findings.issue: Membership goals produced by `Set.Finite.subset`/`Set.Finite.preimage` are never stated; they are closed by proving a bare inequality and `exact`ing it, relying on undocumented `Set.preimage`/`Set.mem_setOf_eq` beta-defeq. Same sites: Sublevel.lean:149 (`have hxc … := hx`), 151-159 (`have hgoal … exact hgoal`), 170-173 (same pattern), 184-186 (`hmem … := le_refl _`); NegativeDefinite.lean:198 (`have hxx … := hx`) and 218 (`exact fun v => Set.mem_Icc.mpr …` against a preimage goal). `have hgoal : X := by …; exact hgoal` is a `show X` in disguise, so a reader cannot tell what the goal actually is.

summary: Two proof-hygiene issues: an ad-hoc case split plus nlinarith reimplements the standard integer fact |a| ≤ a², and several set-membership goals are discharged through undocumented `Set.preimage`/`Set.mem_setOf` defeq via a `have hgoal … exact hgoal` idiom that never states the goal.
